messages:
rajesh: Heads up — we are seeing multiple login failures for partner-corp users. JIT provisioning is firing but failing to map roles when the SAML assertion has no email claim. Some accounts ended up getting the org-admin default_role in the DB.
jess: Any sample SAML assertion or logs?
rajesh: Pasting sanitized log snippet:
```
2026-03-18T14:31:12Z [auth] user_id=null assertion_id=abc123 jit: missing required attribute 'email' -> fallback_role='org-admin' assigned
stack: services/auth/jit_provisioner.go:142
```
kevin: Wait — default_role should never be org-admin for JIT fallbacks. That mapping lives in auth-config -> jit.default_role. I thought we set that to 'none' last quarter.
amy: We changed the Okta attribute mapping for partner-corp on 2026-03-18 to use `login` instead of `email` per their request (reduced PII). Some partners are still sending empty `login` for some service accounts.
okta-bot: Audit: mapping update by admin@okta at 2026-03-18T14:22:03Z (change-id x7f2)
maria: If an assertion lacks the required identity attribute we should reject the assertion, not create an account with elevated fallback. Two immediate asks:
  1) Make missing email/login a hard fail for JIT.
  2) Audit and remediate any accounts created with fallback roles since 2026-03-18.
jess: Agreed. We need a tiny code change and a DB cleanup script.
kevin: I'll open a hotfix PR to change JIT behavior: if required attrs (email or login) missing -> return 401 and no user created. Also change default_role to 'none' so no implicit elevation. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth/pull/842
rajesh: I'll run a query to find auto-provisioned users created by JIT between 2026-03-18 and now and list those with role >= org-admin.
amy: Also check KMS/audit logs for these accounts — we need to be sure no key access occurred. They shouldn't have any in our normal flow but double-checking.
rajesh: Confirmed: KMS audit shows no data-plane accesses by those accounts. Only metadata calls (list-keys) by service principal.
kevin: Hotfix deployed to canary at 2026-03-18T15:05 UTC. Rolling to prod in 10m. I'll monitor auth error rate and 5xxs. :rocket:
okta-bot: Okta webhook delivery: 2/3 retries for partner-corp; some assertions delayed.
maria: Nice. Rajesh — please attach the remediation plan and SQL when you have it. Also we should notify security compliance (CC: legal) because role assignment touched admin scope.
rajesh: Remediation plan (short):
```
1) Disable JIT for partner-corp SAML app until mapping fixed.
2) Run SQL to find JIT-created users:
   SELECT id, email, created_at, source_app FROM users WHERE created_via='saml_jit' AND created_at >= '2026-03-18';
3) For each user with role IN ('org-admin','team-admin') revoke role and set status='suspended'; send email to partner admin.
4) Re-run audit to confirm no KMS or infra access.
```
jess: I'll take ownership of outreach to partner-corp to ask them to fix the attribute mapping (make email/login present) and coordinate re-enable.
kevin: Monitoring looks clean on canary. Rolling to prod now.
maria: Filing a short incident record and compliance notification.
kevin: Incident filed: INC-2026-127 (low severity, principal-of-least-privilege violation). I'll attach PR and logs.
rajesh: Done — ran cleanup and revoked elevated roles for 4 accounts. Notifying partner and legal. Closing the thread once incident doc is attached.
maria: Thanks everyone. Follow-up: add automated test to auth-e2e to cover missing-attribute rejection so JIT doesn't regress. :thumbsup:
